title: 第12章 又在画你那该死的葫芦娃2（别养了求追读）
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

漫画啊…

当贺舟漫画这两个字说出去了后，还是第一次从这群阴间人的眼睛里看出了几丝清澈的愚蠢。

这才对嘛！

这才是属于学生的眼神！

可下一秒。

就看到他们交头接耳的讨论半天，然后回了他一句：“为了保险起见，我建议你就算是漫画，漫画里的七个孩子灵魂被镇压在山里时，也不要带着怨恨，而要带着笑容。”

“虽然没有资料显示漫画角色的怨恨对妖魔的影响，但是还是保险些好。”

“……”

贺舟有些忍无可忍，强调：“这是一本正能量！热血！热！血！番！”

虽然连他自己也不确定小时候看葫芦娃的时候，是不是热血番。

但是对比起这个阴间漫画，葫芦娃那绝对是热血番！

实验班里只有用来勾勒妖魔的水彩笔，水彩这种东西，贺舟觉得自己有点把握不好，但是也没得挑，只能用这个了。

忽然，一只纤细白嫩的手握住一盒水彩蜡笔递过来：“是需要这个吗？”

“需要！”

眼前这一盒显然是儿童画才用得上的蜡笔，虽然颜色也不多，才十二色，但是对自己来说，就是最好用的！

接过这一盒蜡笔，贺舟拿出手机想转账，耳边就听到了惊叹声。

“哇！江月夜学姐哎！”

“他怎么会认识江月夜学姐？”

如果说他们实验班资源多，那二年级已经进入夜巡人部的夜巡人资源是最多的，也能享受学校最好的条件。

听到了声音的贺舟一抬头，竟然就是那天提着灯顶着一张观音面白裙飘飘的江月夜，她在把东西递过来：“那天的试卷我看到了，全对，很厉害。”

在她一出现。

人气值刷刷刷的开始涨。

【人气值增加0.001】

【人气值增加0.001】

评论也终于出现了几条。

但是大部分是催他画葫芦娃的老漫画粉。

【怎么还不画漫画？我的下饭乐子漫画啊！快点更新啊！】

【别装逼撩妹了，赶紧画……等会！来借蜡笔了？所以这次不是黑白简笔画了？即将是有颜色了？期待住了！！】

【你才发现？】

看着冒出来的几条评论，贺舟那种身在这种阴间地方的心情才稍微好了些。

“数学吗？那是因为题目不难，所以…”

“我夸的不是你的数学。”

江月夜提着灯，莹莹烛光，她站在那如神女一般：“当然，你的数学也很不错。”

“在这样的一个……学校里，还有心思学习数学的，全校就你一个。”

贺舟莫名懂了她的意思。

被夸了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Comics...

After the words He Zhou Comics were spoken, it was the first time that I saw a trace of clear stupidity in the eyes of these people from the underworld.

This is right!

This is the look that belongs to students!

But the next second.

I saw them discussing in whispers for a long time, and then replied to him: "To be on the safe side, I suggest that even if it is a comic, when the souls of the seven children in the comic are suppressed in the mountains, you should not be resentful, but smile."

"Although there is no data showing the impact of the resentment of comic characters on monsters, it is better to be safe."

"..."

He Zhou couldn't bear it anymore and emphasized: "This is a book with positive energy! Hot blood! Hot! Blood! Fan!"

Although even he himself was not sure whether it was a hot-blooded show when he watched Calabash Baby when he was a child.

But compared to this underworld comic, Calabash's one is definitely a hot-blooded one!

The only watercolor pens in the experimental class were used to outline monsters. He Zhou felt that he was not sure about watercolors, but he had no choice but to use this.

Suddenly, a slender white hand held a box of watercolor crayons and handed it over: "Do you need this?"

"Need!"

The box of crayons in front of me is obviously only used for children's drawings. Although there are not many colors, only twelve colors, for me, they are the best ones!

After taking the box of crayons, He Zhou took out his mobile phone and wanted to transfer money, but he heard exclamations in his ears.

"Wow! Senior Jiang Yueye!"

"How does he know Senior Sister Jiang Yueye?"

If their experimental class has many resources, then the second-year night patrol members who have entered the night patrol department have the most resources and can enjoy the best conditions in the school.

When He Zhou heard the voice, he looked up and saw that it was Jiang Yueye who was holding a lamp and wearing a white dress with a Guanyin face fluttering on her head that day. She was handing something over: "I saw the test paper that day. It's all correct. It's amazing."

As soon as she appeared.

The popularity started to rise.

[Popularity value increased by 0.001]

[Popularity value increased by 0.001]

A few comments finally appeared.

But most of them were old comic fans who urged him to draw Calabash.

[Why don’t you draw comics yet?My comic about eating fun!Update quickly!】

[Stop pretending to flirt with girls, hurry up and draw...Wait a minute!Come to borrow crayons?So this time it’s not a black and white simple drawing?Will it be available in color soon?Looking forward to it!!】

【Did you just find out?】

Looking at the few comments that popped up, He Zhou felt a little better about being in such a hellish place.

"Mathematics? That's because the questions are not difficult, so..."

"It's not your math I'm praising you for."

Jiang Yueye held a lamp, and under the flickering candlelight, she stood there like a goddess: "Of course, you are also very good at mathematics."

"In a...school like this, you are the only one in the whole school who still cares about studying mathematics."

He Zhou somehow understood what she meant.

Being praised.
